timeline.observed: Initial supplied 5174 URL opened unrelated login page; no login, keys, settings or application actions performed.
Root corrected URL to5178 after finding Vite auto-fell through occupied5174–5177 ports.
Native dedicated window confirmed Draivio title,500×625 fixture,81% view zoom, layer/history/AI Composer UI.
Diagnostic brush selection and coordinate attempts were interrupted by editor becoming completely dark/blank; AX editor subtree disappeared. Screenshot corroborated blank state.

Reload restored fixture editor. Diagnostic brush selection and AX interaction click showed one coral dot at fixture center. This is only visible diagnostic behavior, not a counted all-path verification or RGBA/history/save/export claim.
Root explicitly requested UI pause because R01/F01 repairs are actively changing sources. Dedicated window left at5178; no further actions/reloads.
Root resumed audit using frozen static build at5189; dedicated native Chrome window confirmed correct URL and title.
Brush and pencil selections with canvas drags produced two visible coral lines on fixture; screenshot result not decoded-pixel or persistence proof.

Gradient-brush selected (fresh AX label 渐变画笔 plus end-color field). Canvas drags at [1400,1050]→[1650,1100] attempted twice. Subsequent screenshot still showed pencil toolbar and prior two strokes, while AX showed gradient; new gradient output inconclusive.

Undo attempts via stale AX, direct coordinate and Cmd+Z did not establish removal/restoration; stale AX attempt toggled Composer mode. Inconclusive automation evidence, not a deterministic undo defect.
Fresh brush menu selected straight brush. Subsequent AX confirmed 直线画笔 and 拖动绘制直线. Canvas gesture failed with native CUA error -10005 noWindowsAvailable.

Discovery still listed Chrome running and no browser providers. Rebinding getApp returned correct5189 editor AX; subsequent drag and click each again failed noWindowsAvailable. UI phase ended without remaining tool gestures, save/reopen, or export.
